name: Potion of Tirelessness

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: For 24 hours you need no sleep and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest is 4 hours of quiet focus.
text: For 24 hours after drinking this potion you don't need to sleep and magic can't put you to sleep. During that time a Long Rest takes only 4 hours, spent awake in quiet focus. (The party's rests still take their usual time.)
